function: Excluded as above_phy: the learned Decision Transformer plans AAV trajectory and user scheduling to minimize age of information, no power, resource or beam control (pp. 1, 3, 5).
notes: Step 1 code 4 (above_phy). p. 1: "optimize trajectory planning and user scheduling"; p. 5: "optimizing path planning and user scheduling to minimize average AoI"; p. 3: the action is the AAV flight distance, flight angle and AAV-user association. p. 4: "with a power of Pu = 0.5 W. The channel bandwidth is B = 1 MHz" are fixed inputs, so no physical-layer decision (power, resource, beam) is learned and the aerial exception of step 1 does not apply. The paper has no tables; figures read as page images. Title on p. 1 matches; DOI printed on p. 1 matches.
